typedown.openByDefault.description: When enabled, shows instructions for setting WYSIWYG as the default editor. The editor is always available via "Open With..." or context menu.
typedown.openByDefault.markdownDescription:
When enabled, shows instructions for configuring `workbench.editorAssociations` to make WYSIWYG the default editor for markdown files.

**Note:** The extension does NOT automatically set `workbench.editorAssociations` to avoid race conditions and startup issues. To set WYSIWYG as default, manually add this to your settings:

```json
"workbench.editorAssociations": {
  "*.md": "typedown.markdownEditor"
}
```

Alternatively, use "Open With..." from the context menu to choose the editor for individual files.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run build:editor && NODE_ENV=production webpack --mode production
